name: personal-vault
description: Search and save notes to a paired personal document vault.
long_description: Uses the Personal Vault Connector configuration already paired on this Windows account. Search results include stable document and revision IDs with precise evidence locators.

tools.name: fetch_evidence
tools.description: Expand a result with adjacent evidence.

tools.name: inspect_visual
tools.description: Inspect one retained document, image, or video preview.

tools.name: calculate_spreadsheet
tools.description: Calculate over persisted cells with a cited range.

tools.name: collection_status
tools.description: Show collection readiness and source availability.

tools.name: save_chat_note
tools.description: Explicitly save a user-authored note to the configured source destination.
